hints.title: Line of Waiting Customers
hints.text: At each rotation, new customers arrive and line up for the next gondola.

hints.title: Board at Most Four
hints.text: At most four waiting customers board each rotation, reducing queue size.

hints.title: Continue While Waiting
hints.text: Even after all arrival rounds end, continue rotating until the queue is completely empty.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minOperationsMaxProfit(self, customers: list[int], boardingCost: int, runningCost: int) -> int:
        waiting = 0
        boarded = 0
        max_profit = 0
        best_rotations = -1
        rotations = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(customers) or waiting > 0:
            if i < len(customers):
                waiting += customers[i]
                i += 1
            board = min(4, waiting)
            waiting -= board
            boarded += board
            rotations += 1
            profit = boarded * boardingCost - rotations * runningCost
            if profit > max_profit:
                max_profit = profit
                best_rotations = rotations
        return best_rotations
```

variables: n is number of arrival rounds
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Stopping simulation when customers list ends ignores customers still waiting in line.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating round by round uses O(1) state variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should return -1 if profit is never strictly positive (> 0).
